Chargrilled corn with lime mayo, cotija, chilli and coriander. Brush the corn with melted butter and cook in a very hot grill pan, turning, for 10 minutes until charred all over. Mix the mayonnaise with the zest and juice of 1 lime. Brush the hot corn with the lime mayo, roll in crumbled cotija, dust with chilli and scatter with coriander. Serve with lime wedges.
Corn chips baked with black beans, melted cheddar and sliced jalapeños

Corn chips layered with cheddar, jalapeños and black beans, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, then sour cream and salsa. Spread a 300g bag of corn chips on a tray. Scatter over a drained tin of black beans, 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until melted. Top with sour cream and a jar of salsa.
Smoky buttered pretzels and peanuts, baked and bagged for the ride
Toss 200g hard pretzels and 200g roasted peanuts with 50g melted butter and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Spread on a tray and bake at 160C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool and tip into paper bags.
M: Grilled lime and orange marinated skirt steak in double corn tortillas, salsa verde
Carne asada: skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin, grilled hot, chopped, in doubled corn tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa verde.
Pop quiz, hotshot. Harry's line, before the elevator job goes sideways

Crumbed chicken thigh burgers with slaw, pickles and chipotle mayo on toasted brioche. Flatten the chicken, then dip in flour, beaten egg and panko. Shallow fry in the oil for 4 minutes a side until golden and cooked through. Mix half the mayonnaise with the chopped chipotle. Toss the shredded cabbage with the rest and the lime juice. Toast the buns, spread with chipotle mayo and fill with chicken, slaw and pickles.
W: Fifty mile an hour ice cream sandwiches
Vanilla ice cream between soft chocolate chip cookies

Soft choc chip cookies sandwiched with a thick slab of vanilla ice cream, edges rolled in sprinkles, frozen hard for an hour. Soften 1L vanilla ice cream for 5 minutes. Sandwich a thick scoop between two soft choc chip cookies, using 8 cookies for 4 sandwiches. Roll the edges in sprinkles, wrap in baking paper and freeze for an hour.
K: Overnight cold brew over ice with milk and a scoop of vanilla ice cream
Iced coffee: cold brew over ice with milk and a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

Bake until melted.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160C. Melt the butter and stir in the smoked paprika.
Toss the pretzels and peanuts in the paprika butter and spread on a lined tray.
Bake for 15 minutes, stirring once halfway.
Cool on the tray and tip into paper bags.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the lime mayo up to 1 day ahead; grill the corn just before serving

steps.text: Brush the corn with melted butter and cook in a very hot grill pan, turning, for 10 minutes until charred all over.
Mix the mayonnaise with the zest and juice of 1 lime.
Brush the hot corn with the lime mayo, roll in crumbled cotija, dust with chilli and scatter with coriander. Serve with lime wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the steak up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill on the night

steps.text: Juice the limes and orange, mix with the crushed garlic and cumin and marinate the steak.
Leave to marinate.
Grill very hot on both sides.
Rest the steak, then chop.
Dice the onion and warm the tortillas.
Serve in doubled tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa verde.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the mushrooms up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge, any longer and they go soft; grill on the night

steps.text: Juice the limes and orange, mix with the crushed garlic, cumin, oil and salt and coat the mushrooms.
Leave to marinate.
Grill very hot for 4 minutes a side.
Rest the mushrooms, then chop.
Dice the onion and warm the tortillas.
Serve in doubled tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa verde.

dishes.make_ahead: Crumb the chicken and make the slaw dressing up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Flatten the chicken, then dip in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Shallow fry in the oil for 4 minutes a side until golden and cooked through.
Mix half the mayonnaise with the chopped chipotle. Toss the shredded cabbage with the rest and the lime juice.
Toast the buns, spread with chipotle mayo and fill with chicken, slaw and pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the eggplant and make the slaw dressing up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Cut the eggplant into thick rounds, salt them, then dip in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Shallow fry in the oil for 4 minutes a side until golden and soft.
Mix half the mayonnaise with the chopped chipotle. Toss the shredded cabbage with the rest and the lime juice.
Toast the buns, spread with chipotle mayo and fill with eggplant, slaw and pickles.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and freeze up to 1 week ahead, wrapped; take out 5 minutes before serving

steps.text: Soften the ice cream.
Sandwich a thick scoop between two cookies.
Roll the edges in sprinkles and wrap in baking paper.
Freeze until firm.

dishes.make_ahead: Steep the coffee in the fridge and strain up to 3 days ahead; pour over ice with the milk and ice cream on the night

steps.text: Stir the coffee into the cold water.
Steep in the fridge overnight.
Strain.
Pour over ice in tall glasses, add a splash of milk and float a scoop of ice cream on top.

m.note: Chargrilled citrus skirt steak in doubled corn tortillas
m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak in the juice of 2 limes and 1 orange, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 2 hours. Grill very hot for 3 minutes a side, rest and chop. Serve in doubled corn tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa verde.

d.note: Cold brew over ice with milk and a scoop of ice cream
d.how: Steep 100g coarsely ground coffee in 1L cold water in the fridge overnight, then strain. Pour over ice in four tall glasses, about 200ml each, add a splash of milk and float a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top.
